title: Codifferential Calculi on Quantum Homogeneous Spaces
summary: We develop the theory of first- and higher-order codifferential calculi over coalgebras $C$ over fields $k$ with characteristic $\mathrm{char}(k)\neq 2$. For a given first-order codifferential calculus, we introduce its maximal prolongation by means of an explicit construction that associates to it a differential graded coalgebra, satisfying a universal property. For module coalgebras over a Hopf algebra $U$, we introduce the notion of an equivariant codifferential calculus.
